title: The Mughals Conspiracy Against Banda Singh And their Eulogy of (Tat Khalsa) Singhs

blocks.text: Episode 62 opens in Lahore with fear already thick in the city, while pirs, mullas, and Qur’an-recitation are marshaled as part of the imperial psychological theater against Banda.
Drums, slogans of Ali Ali, and ritual protections give the advance an atmosphere of forced confidence rather than actual security.
Ali Ali is the most distinct anchor because it marks the page’s fusion of martial procession and religious invocation.
